title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: End on a success
hook: How do your players feel walking to the car after practice?
intro: The last drill was the hardest one.
Kids leave tired and a little frustrated.
statement: The last few minutes are what kids remember.
q1: Do you end with a drill they already do well —
q2: or end on the hard work and push through?
q3: What do you want them saying on the way home?
t1: Both can work. But kids come back eager
t2: when practice ends on something they got right.
cta: Coaches — how do you end practice?
ctaLines: A favorite game. A skill they own. A team cheer.
ctaPrompt: Share your closing habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How do your players feel walking to the car after practice?
The last drill was the hardest one. Kids leave tired and a little frustrated.
The last few minutes are what kids remember.
End on a success or end on the hard part. Every team is different.
How do you end practice? Share your habit in the comments.
